sources.title: Qwen 3 8B - Open Source AI Models
sources.snippet: The April 2025 refresh of Qwen at 8B. Native mixed-mode reasoning: the model can 'think' before answering when triggered, or answer directly for simple queries — configurable per request. Apache 2.0. A strong upgrade over Qwen 2.5 7B on math and code, with much better instruction following.
